description: ADV-CHG-1 / CHG-OPT-1 / MELEE-SEEK-2 / MAKARI-R1. Battle round 1, P1 (Orks) Movement. Ghazghkull (M8, not riled up, no Waaagh! called) stands 16" (base edge to edge) from P2's Custodian Guard Sodality. At Movement phase entry the AI decides the movement_phase_start window: it spends MAKARI, HOIST DAT BANNER! in round 1 on Ghazghkull because riling him up turns a 42% Move-then-charge into an ~84% Advance-then-charge. Suggest (K) then shows the new scored 'Advance → charge Custodian Guard Sodality' option picked over the objective moves, with its charge odds. Letting the AI play (both seats AI so the Custodes seat answers its own saves): Ghazghkull Advances at the Guard and declares the charge in the Charge phase (allowed: riled up).
